newsitem.title: USA: Landing gear on Delta 727 collapses, minor injuries.
newsitem.headline: Landing gear on Delta 727 collapses, minor injuries.

text.p: The landing gear of a Delta Airlines 727 passenger jet collapsed on the runway after it landed at Albuquerque International Airport Sunday causing minor injuries to some passengers, airport officials said.

Dennis Parker, assistant aviation director at Albuquerque International Airport said the accident occured at around 5 p.m. MDT (7 p.m. EDT) when the plane's right landing gear touched down on the runway.
"We have the airplane off the runway and the airport is open for business as usual," Parker said.
Parker said he did not know how many passengers were aboard or how many people were injured.
